author: thecamper4444
quote: Arthur's story is, without a doubt, a well-executed work of art. It's inspiring, moving, and leaves a lasting impression on you as a player. Its graphics and mechanics laid the foundation for later gaming, including GTA 6, which in my opinion makes it one of the most influential games in history, despite the fact that its story initially feels slow and many players have given up on this masterpiece for that reason.

quote: It's an overrated game that survives on nostalgia; its remake is decent, but we're talking about 1998, hence my rating.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: thecamper4444
quote: A revolutionary and highly anticipated game that, in my opinion, lived up to all expectations and marked a turning point in the industry, with great potential when it expands to PC and the online mode arrives with its possible expansions.
